lead: Milkha Singh was an Indian athletics competitor, born on 20 November 1929 in Govindpura.
He died on 18 June 2021 in Chandigarh at the age of 91.
He is associated with work such as The Race of My Life and has been recognised with the Padma Shri in sports.
Below you will find a verified overview of Milkha Singh: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
